newsitem.title: FRANCE: SDV shares remain suspended - SBF.
newsitem.headline: SDV shares remain suspended - SBF.

text.p: France's stock markets association, the SBF, said on Tuesday that trading in the shares of Scac Delmas Vieljeux (SCV), would remain suspended until further notice.
Bollore Technologies said earlier in the day that its board had approved plans to buy out SCV, a transport unit in which it already holds 73.83 percent.
The SBF said in a statement that the bourse watchdog body, the CBV, would later take a decision on the acceptability of the offer, which was first announced on July 19.
